<div class="card-body">
'''Dutch''' is the Japanese-language [[Premiere (Japanese)]] printing of [[Dutch]].<ref name="encyclopedia">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41 and 98 (index 3955). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>


<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ダッチ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に＋２。ゴールド１に乗っていれば、回避値に＋１でき、戦闘運命数が引けない場合に、１枚だけ引ける。同じ位置にいる同じ位置にいるゴールド中隊の他のパイロットは全員没収値に＋１。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-dutch-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ジョン・「ダッチ」・ヴァンダー。ヤヴィンの戦いでゴールド中隊を指揮。愛機はＹウイング。元はレンフォーラ基地のスペクター中隊指揮官。ヘルメットにそのエンブレムがある。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Dutch.

'''Card text:''' Adds 2 to the power of a starship he pilots. Aboard Gold 1, he may add 1 to maneuver and draw one battle destiny if none can otherwise be drawn. All other Gold Squadron pilots at the same site are forfeit +1.

'''Lore:''' Jon “Dutch” Vander commanded Gold Squadron at the Battle of Yavin. He flies a Y-wing. Formerly commander of Specter Squadron at Renforra Base, whose emblem is on his helmet.
<h2>Notes</h2>
The Japanese game text repeats the phrase meaning “at the same site” twice in its final sentence.<ref name="jp-face" />
